description_en: Checks the prerequisites for column encryption on an instance
description_zh: 检查实例列加密前置条件
name: CheckDataMaskingInstance

parameters.help_en:
The cloud service type identifier. Valid values:
5: RDS
8: POLARDB
27: PolarDBX2
If this parameter is specified together with ProductCode, the values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud service code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also specified, the two parameters must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The database instance identity. You can obtain the value from Items[].InstanceId in the response of ListDataMaskingInstances
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

ErrorCode.description_en: The instance check result code. A value of Success indicates that the check is passed. For other values, refer to ErrorMessage for troubleshooting
ErrorCode.description_zh: 实例检查结果码。Success 表示检查通过；其他值应结合 ErrorMessage 处理

ErrorMessage.description_en: The instance check result message. If the check fails, the specific cause is returned
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 实例检查结果说明；检查失败时返回具体原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
